dialogue_texts: Ah... gasp... The freezing dark inside me... is it warming up? My chest doesn't feel heavy anymore...
The darkness has receded beautifully. Your normal color has returned.
Now, little one, who was it that offered you this counterfeit eternity?
A woman... dressed in an elegant, dark gothic dress.
She approached me from Mayohiga... she whispered that an isolated heart is a perfect heart...
A lady in gothic attire near Mayohiga... Berenice Grieg, if I recall the rumors.
Trying to create a flawless world through forced isolation is quite a grand delusion.
Since the perpetrator is lurking near Mayohiga...
We should advance swiftly to neutralize her before she targets any more innocent spirits!
It would be dreadfully boring if the rest of Gensokyo fell asleep before I could enjoy the festival.
Lead the way to Mayohiga, Shirogane-sama!
